dialogue.origin: （おはようございます。本日は宜しくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Good morning. I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.origin: おはようございます今日は相談者役やらせていただきますよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Good morning. I will be playing the role of the client today. It's a pleasure to work with you.

dialogue.origin: （時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.content: (We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: 承知しました！
dialogue.content: Understood!

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別を差し支えなければ教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender, if you don't mind?

dialogue.origin: ４６歳　女性ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: I'm a 46-year-old woman. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 夫の妹とのコミュニケーションの取り方について相談したいです
dialogue.content: I'd like to talk about how to communicate with my husband's younger sister.

dialogue.origin: ご相談いただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: 夫の妹様とのコミュニケーションということですが、どういったところで悩まれているかもう少し教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned communication with your husband's sister. Could you tell me a little more about what you're struggling with?

dialogue.origin: はい、いつもラインで何かあれば相談してくるのですが、どんな悩みの話でも最後は義母の愚痴になっています
dialogue.content: Yes, she always contacts me via LINE whenever she has something on her mind, but no matter what the issue is, it always ends up turning into complaints about our mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことがおありだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see—that's been happening.

dialogue.origin: 義母は私に対しては親切で優しい人なんです
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law is kind and gentle toward me.

dialogue.origin: でも義妹からすれば、自分の事しか考えていない、何もできない人という認識らしく
dialogue.content: But from my sister-in-law's perspective, she seems to see her as selfish and incapable.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 嫁と娘だと立場が違いますし、感じ方が違う事は当然だと思います
dialogue.content: Being a daughter-in-law versus a daughter, our positions are different, so I think it's natural that we feel differently.

dialogue.origin: そのように思っておられるのですね
dialogue.content: So that's how you see it.

dialogue.origin: でも最終的に私にいつも義母の嫌な面を同意させようとしてくる感じが嫌だなと感じています
dialogue.content: But in the end, it feels like she's always trying to get me to agree with the negative aspects of our mother-in-law, and that bothers me.

dialogue.origin: ええそうだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what's been happening.

dialogue.origin: 優しい義母様の愚痴を聞くのは心苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: It must be painful to hear complaints about your kind mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです私は私の価値観があるから、母の事は好き、それを伝えるでも妹はそれを聞くと自分の母への気持ちがわがままだと否定されているように感じるのかなあと思っています
dialogue.content: That's right. I have my own values, and I like my mother-in-law, so I tell her that. But when my sister-in-law hears it, I wonder if she feels as though her feelings toward her mother are being dismissed as selfish.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですねそこで気持ちが入違ってしまっていると感じておられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you feel that's where your feelings are misaligned.

dialogue.origin: そうですね妹の気持ちは分かるけれど同感はできないということをわかってもらえればもう少し楽なコミュニケーションができるのにな…と思っています
dialogue.content: That's right. I think communication would be a bit easier if she could understand that while I understand her feelings, I can't sympathize with them.

dialogue.origin: ええ各々の価値観がある、というのを分かってほしいという思いですね
dialogue.content: Right—you'd like her to understand that each of you has your own values.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 義母様と義妹様とはなにかトラブルなどはあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have there been any incidents or conflicts between your mother-in-law and your sister-in-law?

dialogue.origin: 妹いわく昔叱られる時にほっぺたをつねられたり、して意地悪なお母さんという心のキズも深くなってしまったと
dialogue.content: According to my sister-in-law, when she was scolded as a child, her mother would pinch her cheeks, and that has deepened her emotional scars, making her see her mother as mean.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see—that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: 昔からコミュニケーションが上手くいかないときがあったのですね
dialogue.content: So there have been communication issues between them since long ago.

dialogue.origin: 中学生からは、そういう親子の心の距離から妹はお婆ちゃんと一緒に住んで、少し離れたところに家族は別にすんでたそうです
dialogue.content: From junior high school, because of that emotional distance between parent and child, my sister-in-law lived with her grandmother, while the rest of the family lived separately a short distance away.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことがあったのですね
dialogue.content: I see that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですだから妹のつらい気持ちも分かるとってもつらいと思うんです
dialogue.content: Yes. So I do understand my sister-in-law's pain; I think it's very hard for her.

dialogue.origin: ええ辛いお気持ちもあるかと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I can imagine she has some painful feelings.

dialogue.origin: 義妹様のお気持ちも汲んでお話を聞いているということですね
dialogue.content: So you listen to her while also considering her feelings.

dialogue.origin: そうですねでもだからと言ってつらいのは私ではないので、私は母は好きです自分の実母より気が合うくらいなので
dialogue.content: That's right. But that doesn't mean it's my pain, so I like my mother-in-law. We get along even better than I do with my own mother.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね素敵なご関係ですね
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds like a wonderful relationship.

dialogue.origin: 義母様は義妹様のことについてはどのように思っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does your mother-in-law feel about your sister-in-law?

dialogue.origin: うーん母は立派な人なので、娘を悪くは言いませんがいつも怒ってて怖いと言ってます
dialogue.content: Hmm. My mother-in-law is a respectable person, so she doesn't speak ill of her daughter, but she says her daughter is always angry and scary.

dialogue.origin: そのように思っておられるのですね
dialogue.content: So that's how she feels.

dialogue.origin: 余計な事を言うとすぐおこられると言ってます
dialogue.content: She says her daughter gets angry right away if she says anything unnecessary.

dialogue.origin: ええなるほどですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: 娘の子育ても見ていてハラハラする事が多いようです
dialogue.content: It seems she often feels anxious watching her daughter's parenting.

dialogue.origin: ついつい心配になって、なにか言ってしまうみたいな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it something like she gets worried and can't help but say something?

dialogue.origin: そうですね母はとっても心配性です
dialogue.content: That's right. My mother-in-law is a big worrier.

dialogue.origin: ええそういう方なのですね
dialogue.content: Yes, so that's the kind of person she is.

dialogue.origin: 私は義母から全く子育てについて何も言われなかったし、むしろいつも誉めて労ってくれました
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law never said anything to me about child-rearing; in fact, she always praised and showed appreciation for my efforts.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら妹母、私に相談しながら、母と良好な関係を結べていることに、不快な思いがあるのかもしれない…と今思いました
dialogue.content: I just realized... maybe my sister-in-law feels uncomfortable that I'm able to have a good relationship with her mother while she consults me about her.

dialogue.origin: 妹は私を頼りにしながらも義母と私の関係を崩したいと思っているのかも
dialogue.content: Perhaps while relying on me, my sister-in-law also wants to undermine my relationship with my mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね横で見ていると、あまりいい気がしないと思ってしまうかもということですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you're thinking that watching from the sidelines might not feel very good for her.

dialogue.origin: 義妹様から連絡が来たりするのはいつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Since when has your sister-in-law been contacting you like this?

dialogue.origin: 夫と結婚する前から、仲良くしていて、定期的に相談は受けていましたが
dialogue.content: We were on good terms even before I married her brother, and she would consult me regularly.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 母との確執について話だしたのは、私が夫の転勤で実家近くに引っ越してきた9年前くらいからです
dialogue.content: She started talking about her feud with her mother about nine years ago, when I moved near my husband's family home due to his job transfer.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですねその間色々な相談を受けながら、義母様と義妹様との板挟みのような状態になったしまっている、ということでよろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. So over that time, while receiving various consultations, you've ended up feeling caught between your mother-in-law and sister-in-law. Is that correct?

dialogue.origin: はいそうですね２０歳くらいから妹は摂食障害になっていましたので、心と身体の悩みが多いので、ずっと寄り添っています
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. My sister-in-law has had an eating disorder since she was about 20, so she has many mental and physical struggles, and I've always been there for her.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様としては今後、義妹様とはどのように接していければ良いと考えていらしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: As for you, how would you like to interact with your sister-in-law going forward?

dialogue.origin: このまま悩みがあるときは聞いて、受け入れていきたいですただ
dialogue.content: I'd like to continue listening when she has concerns and accepting them, but—

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 義母も高齢ですので、そろそろ母への攻撃的な言葉や態度は弱めてもらいたいです
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law is getting older, so I'd like her to tone down her aggressive words and attitude toward her mother soon.

dialogue.origin: そのように考えておられるのですね
dialogue.content: That's what you're hoping for.

dialogue.origin: 義母様への態度というのは、変わりそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you think her attitude toward your mother-in-law is likely to change?

dialogue.origin: どうでしょうか…今のところ不満ばかり口にしてますのであまり期待できないかももし母がもっと高齢になって、介護が必要になるまで変わらないかもしれません
dialogue.content: I'm not sure... Right now she only voices complaints, so I can't expect much. It might not change until her mother gets older and needs care.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねたしかに、時間がかかるところかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. Indeed, it may be something that takes time.

dialogue.origin: 母へのつらい思いを持ちながら、私のように義母とは良好な関係を妹も作れればまた違ったのでしょうけれど、自分の夫のお母さんとも上手くいっていません
dialogue.content: Although she has painful feelings toward her mother, if she could build a good relationship with her mother-in-law like I have, things might be different—but she doesn't get along with her own husband's mother either.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね義妹様にも大変な事情があるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So your sister-in-law has her own difficult circumstances.

dialogue.origin: もっといえば夫婦関係も上手くいっていませんし、妹は色んな場面でコミュニケーションが上手く取れない状況です
dialogue.content: To add to that, her marital relationship isn't going well either, and she struggles with communication in various situations.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そんな中、あなたを頼りにしている、という部分もあるのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: In the midst of all that, it may be that she relies on you.

dialogue.origin: そうだと思いますそれを自分に問題があると認めたくなくて、母のせいにし続けています
dialogue.content: I think so. She doesn't want to admit that she's the one with the problem, so she keeps blaming her mother.

dialogue.origin: ええ色々と思う部分があるのだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm sure there are many complicated feelings.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさいそろそろお時間になるのですが、お話したいことは話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, but our time is almost up. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to discuss?

dialogue.origin: いつか気付いてくれればいいな…と思っていつもそこには触れずに気持ちを汲み取るだけで止めています
dialogue.content: I always stop short of touching on that and just try to acknowledge her feelings, hoping that someday she'll realize it on her own.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ええお話を聞かせていただいて、周りの方はあなたを頼りにされているのかなと感じました。
dialogue.content: Yes. After listening to your story, I feel that those around you really rely on you.

dialogue.origin: そのためにまずはあなたが自分のことを大事にしてほしいなと思いました
dialogue.content: Because of that, I think it's important for you to take care of yourself first.

dialogue.origin: なにかお役に立てることがあれば、こちらにいつでもいますのでまたご相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.content: If there's anything I can help with, I'm always here, so please feel free to come back for another consultation.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます身内のことはなかなか相談しにくいので、今日お話できて良かったです
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. It's difficult to talk about family matters, so I'm glad I could talk about it today.

dialogue.origin: ええここでは安心してなんでもお話ししてください
dialogue.content: Yes, please feel free to talk about anything here in a safe space.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日は終了させていただきます。大切なお話ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: That concludes our session for today. Thank you for sharing your important story.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございましたまたモヤモヤしたときこちらなら安心して話せそうと思いました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. I felt that when I'm feeling conflicted again, this is a place where I can speak without worry.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。それでは失礼致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll sign off now.

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでしたありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （相談者役お疲れさまでした。お時間あるときに評価、コメントいただければと思います）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for taking the client role. If you have time, I'd appreciate your evaluation and comments.)

dialogue.origin: はい、承知しました
dialogue.content: Yes, understood.

topic.sub: 義妹とのコミュニケーション問題
